originalExceptionGraphDisposition: R03/R06: original exceptions are local diagnostic references only. Preserve original object identity, reference-deduplicated execution observations, provider AggregateException boundaries and reverse-acquisition cleanup order; admission/rollback belongs in AdmissionError rather than later CleanupErrors. These channels cannot reconstruct a failure already masked inside XmlDb. Exception/Data/InnerException graphs may retain live provider nodes, paths or sensitive state; retention is not detachment, immutable data or renewed authority. Do not serialize/publish the raw exception or run-result graph, blindly call arbitrary exception getters/ToString, or traverse Data/inner provider objects after revocation. Any future export needs owner-controlled bounded allowlisted primitive projection/redaction while required resources remain valid; default to withholding unknown payloads and sensitive paths/URIs. No generic recursive sanitizer, safe-IPC guarantee, automatic release retry or native cleanup success is inferred. No additional Core signature for this local-only diagnostic profile is demonstrated.
